hypotheses.text: If Oscar Lindqvist had shot instead of carrying, the chance of scoring would have been higher and the turnover risk lower, explaining whether shooting was the better option from 22 m.

If Lindqvist had passed to Bastian Holt (LM) instead, the play would have shifted wide and likely reduced the high turnover risk, showing whether a pass to the flank would have preserved possession and increased scoring probability.

If Mateo Brann had been 5 m closer to Lindqvist, Lindqvist would have had a safer short option and been less likely to be tackled, explaining whether teammate proximity would have prevented the turnover.
